An Indian perspective. A builder’s mindset.

Last updated: 2026-10-07
Skip to content ABOUT BharatGoAI An Indian perspective. A builder’s mindset. We’re an India-based AI company exploring how language models and thoughtful engineering can become useful, practical technology. WHY WE BUILD Start with context. Build with intent. BharatGoAI was founded in November 2025 in Hyderabad . We build and adapt India-focused multimodal language models through vision-language fine-tuning, Indian-context evaluation, model quantization and efficient serving with vLLM. Our work connects language and document understanding with practical deployment on accessible hardware. Our mission is to develop useful AI with Indian users and businesses in mind. We’re interested in the full journey: understanding a problem, working with models, exploring efficiency and shaping a practical application. We see language and access as engineering questions as much as design questions. Our work begins with that perspective, and grows through experimentation. COMPANY BharatGoAI FOUNDED November 2025 BASED IN Hyderabad, India FOCUS LLMs · Quantization · AI/ML THE PERSON BEHIND THE WORK LE · Lokesh E Founder & AI/ML Engineer MEET THE FOUNDER Lokesh E Founder & AI/ML Engineer Working where language models meet practical engineering. Lokesh’s work focuses on LLM fine-tuning, quantization and deployment. At BharatGoAI, he brings these interests together through language model development and applied AI/ML projects. Explore his Hugging Face profile for models and datasets, with details available on each project’s own page. Hugging Face GitHub THE WAY WE THINK Principles before promises. Context matters Start with people, language and the problem a model is intended to solve. Details matter Look closely at quality, resource requirements and the trade-offs in every approach. Progress takes care Build iteratively. Make room for feedback. Describe work at the stage it has actually reached. Malkajgiri, Hyderabad, Telangana, India — 500047 About BharatGoAI: questions answered. Who is BharatGoAI? BharatGoAI is an India-focused AI company founded in November 2025 in Hyderabad by Lokesh E, Founder & AI/ML Engineer. What does BharatGoAI build? We build and adapt multimodal language models for Indian-context use, including vision-language fine-tuning, model quantization and efficient serving with vLLM. What stage is the work at? Our India-focused multimodal LLM is in development. Handwritten exam OCR is research, the listed Qwen and Gemma quantization projects are released, and vLLM serving work is ongoing. See individual project pages for details. How can I collaborate with BharatGoAI? Email dev@bharatgoai.com to discuss a research question or AI/ML project. You can explore Lokesh E’s models and datasets on Hugging Face and code on GitHub. Where is BharatGoAI based? BharatGoAI is based in Malkajgiri, Hyderabad, Telangana, India, postal code 500047. From model to meaningful application.
https://bharatgoai.com/products
Last updated: 2026-10-07
Skip to content OUR WORK From model to meaningful application. We build and adapt multimodal language models for Indian-context use cases, and make them efficient enough to deploy. VISION + LANGUAGE 01 BharatGoAI / WORK IN PROGRESS FLAGSHIP DIRECTION India-focused multimodal LLM In development Our core focus is building a multimodal (vision + language) LLM adapted for Indian-context use: handwritten and printed document understanding, Indian-language text, and practical deployment on accessible hardware. We build on open foundation models (Gemma-4 and Qwen3 MoE families) and focus on fine-tuning, reinforcement-learning-based adaptation, quantization and serving. Vision-language fine-tuning (LoRA, GRPO/GSPO-based training) Indian-context data and evaluation Efficient quantization for low-cost deployment Production serving with vLLM Projects Research Handwritten exam OCR Vision-language model fine-tuned with GRPO on Gemma-4 to extract structured fields (roll number, page number, question number, content) from handwritten exam sheets. View on Hugging Face Released Qwen3.6-35B-A3B INT8 INT8-quantized Mixture-of-Experts model prepared for efficient vLLM serving. View on Hugging Face Released Gemma-4 quantization suite FP8, W4A16 and NVFP4 quantized variants of Gemma-4 MoE models using llmcompressor. View on Hugging Face Ongoing Efficient serving with vLLM Deployment recipes for quantized models on A100 and L40S GPUs, including cross-GPU accuracy comparison. Our approach Adapt fine-tune open models for Indian-context tasks Compress quantize models to cut cost and memory Deploy serve with vLLM and test accuracy across hardware THE NEXT CONVERSATION Interested in collaborating or building with us? Skip to content RESEARCH & EXPLORATION Good AI starts with better questions. Our research connects India-focused multimodal language models, vision-language adaptation, quantization and efficient serving with vLLM. 01 Vision-language adaptation How do we adapt models for Indian-context tasks? BharatGoAI focuses on India-focused multimodal models that connect vision and language. Our work includes LoRA fine-tuning and GRPO/GSPO-based adaptation for Indian-context tasks, including handwritten and printed document understanding. Indian-language text and task-specific evaluation are part of the same research direction, alongside practical deployment requirements. Language models Fine-tuning Evaluation 02 Model quantization How do we approach model quantization? Our model quantization work includes INT8, FP8, W4A16 and NVFP4, with deployment through vLLM. We focus on the relationship between model representation, memory use and practical serving. The project collection links to quantized artifacts and identifies the stage of each model or deployment effort. Quantization Model size Output quality 03 Efficient serving with vLLM How does research connect to deployment? BharatGoAI connects model adaptation and quantization with efficient serving through vLLM. The deployment direction includes accessible hardware and accuracy evaluation across hardware. Model artifacts and deployment work are listed separately so readers can distinguish released quantization projects, research experiments and work that remains in development. Applied ML Prototyping Deployment OUR ENGINEERING PERSPECTIVE From a question to a considered answer. A useful framework for thinking about AI/ML projects, from start to finish. 0 1 Define Understand the intended user, the task and the constraints. 0 2 Explore Investigate models, data and approaches that fit the problem. 0 3 Evaluate Compare outcomes and examine quality and resource trade-offs. 0 4 Refine Use what the experiment reveals to shape the next iteration. FOLLOW THE WORK Explore the model work. Find the founder’s model work on Hugging Face. Refer to individual project pages for their documentation, status and licence. Skip to content PRIVACY POLICY Privacy, in plain language. General notes on this website, the information you choose to share and how to reach us with a privacy question. ON THIS PAGE Last updated: 2026-10-07 About these notes These general privacy notes describe the BharatGoAI informational website and enquiries sent to our business email. They do not describe a separate model service, account system or paid product. Any future service may have its own privacy information. Information you share If you email us, we receive the information you choose to send, such as your name, email address, organisation and message. Please avoid sending sensitive personal information, passwords or confidential datasets in an initial enquiry. The contact form prepares a draft in your browser. Form entries are not submitted to a website server or saved in browser storage by this website. When you choose to send the email, your email provider processes it and it reaches our business mailbox. How information is used Enquiry information is used to understand your request, reply to you and continue the conversation where appropriate. Contacting us is not a sign-up for a marketing list. Hosting and external services Website hosting and email services may process technical information needed to deliver their services, such as IP addresses, request times and email metadata. Their handling of this information also depends on their own policies. This website includes links to external profiles on Hugging Face and GitHub. If you follow a link, the destination’s privacy policy applies. This website does not send visitor messages to a model API. Cookies and browser storage Optional privacy-friendly analytics are disabled unless configured and you give consent. No analytics script loads before consent. When enabled, your choice is saved in browser storage and can be withdrawn using the footer control. Contact form entries are not saved in browser storage. Your browser, email app and external websites may have their own storage behaviour. Retention and requests Email correspondence may be retained to handle an enquiry and related follow-up. Retention can depend on the nature of the conversation and applicable obligations; these notes do not promise a fixed retention period or a particular storage location. To ask about access, correction or deletion of information you shared, email dev@bharatgoai.com . We may need information to verify the request and identify the relevant correspondence. Changes to these notes We may update these notes as the website or our work changes. The date on this page identifies the latest update. Have a question? Contact dev@bharatgoai.com or visit our contact page . BharatGoAI Malkajgiri, Hyderabad, Telangana, India — 500047 Last updated: 2026-10-07

They do not promise a release date, a particular capability, performance result or commercial service. Contact us for current project-specific information. A project engagement requires separately agreed terms. Respect the rights and privacy of other people. Content and external projects BharatGoAI branding and original website content belong to BharatGoAI or their respective owners. Contact us if you wish to reuse material beyond what applicable law permits. Code, models and datasets linked from this website may have separate licences. Review the licence and documentation on the relevant project page before using them. Links and availability External links are provided for reference. Their content, availability and terms are controlled by the respective providers. We may update or remove website content, and uninterrupted availability is not guaranteed. Nothing in these terms excludes rights or responsibilities that cannot lawfully be excluded. Governing law and contact These terms are governed by the applicable laws of India.
